title: Canonical common-universe transport of ring and module sheaves
statement: For a site C,J with independent object and Hom universes, a commutative ring sheaf R in universe r, module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] in independent universe m, and an additional ambient size t, lift each ring section to ULift of R(U) and each module section to ULift of M(U), both in max(r,m,t). Ring and module restriction maps apply the original restrictions to ULift.down and then ULift.up; the lifted scalar acts by its descended scalar. The sheaf condition transports through up/down. On homomorphisms use the same up/down formula. This defines a fully faithful additive common-universe embedding. It preserves the existing sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], via the unique isomorphism taking the lifted sheafification of x tensor y to the sheafification of ULift.up(x) tensor ULift.up(y), and preserves the small coproducts used in unbounded cochain totals. Thus all independent sizes can be handled in a common ambient universe without identifying any of them.
